pages.text: Long ago, God's people walked in darkness and were sad. God sent the prophet Isaiah to give them hope.
Isaiah said, "A young woman will have a baby boy, and His name will be Emmanuel, which means God with us. He will be called Prince of Peace."
"The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light!" Isaiah told them. Hundreds of years later, that promise came true when Jesus was born.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God promised to send a Savior, and He kept His promise. At Christmas, we celebrate that Jesus is God with us.
